phase_e_rate_limit.observed_semantics: per-process enforcement: one ip-identity exhausted r1's burst (10 passes) and immediately obtained a fresh 10-pass allowance on r2 (E1->E2, ~0.25 s apart); the principal identity through the LB received 20 passes = 10+10 across the two replica limiters (E3). Aggregate allowance scales with replica selection, as documented (api/rate_limit.py:25-30); the issue's 'cannot be bypassed by replica selection' criterion is NOT met by this design and requires a shared-store budget decision.
